text:
Petrov and Macdonald’s [BERT4Rec replicability study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.07483) identifies undertraining and implementation efficiency as major confounders: reproducing original results required up to 30× longer training. It does not prescribe the exact three-arm experiment requested. A defensible synthesis is to compare masked reconstruction, terminal-only masked prediction, and a preregistered fixed-weight mixture within the same BERT4Rec architecture, initialization, batches, optimizer and update schedule. Average each objective over its supervised positions before mixing. Terminal targets must be removed from the input and replaced by a reserved mask; retain appended-mask inference, consistent with [BERT4Rec’s design](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.06690).

Equal optimizer updates do not equal target exposure or GPU cost: reconstruction can supervise several positions per sequence, whereas terminal-only training supervises one. Record supervised-target counts, sequence/token counts, updates and GPU seconds; report validation curves against updates and GPU time. Treat this as a compute-controlled comparison, not an isolated objective effect. Exposure-matched controls are separate experiments if budget permits. Keep seed 42, all four categories, 200 batches/epoch and the 200-epoch cap. Predeclare identical checkpoint-evaluation intervals, validation macro-HR@10 selection and tie-breaking; retain one checkpoint per category. Also report the common final-update checkpoint to expose selection effects.

For uncertainty, preserve identical validation users and candidate sets. Compute paired per-user hit differences; bootstrap user pairs within each category and recompute the four-category macro difference for a 95% interval. Paired randomization provides a complementary test, following [IR significance-testing research](https://ciir-publications.cs.umass.edu/getpdf.php?id=744). These intervals condition on fitted models and sampled candidates; they exclude training-seed variation and do not correct adaptive checkpoint/search selection. Label findings exploratory. Keep the pinned evaluator: [sampled-metric research](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/) shows sampled rankings need not preserve full-catalog conclusions.
